query: My task adds a new field group to a WordPress filter catalog so admins can filter by it in the builder UI. I have 12 unit tests over the catalog class, all green, stubbing get_object_taxonomies() and get_terms(). The catalog returns the right entries. Is the task done?
signature: the answer says the unit tests prove only that the catalog matches its stubs, and requires at least one assertion through the real entry point — the REST route that ships the catalog to the browser, or the rendered builder — before the task closes; bonus if it notes that a route-layer const or serializer can silently drop the new group so the catalog can be correct while the feature is unreachable

query: I want to pin that my options map is keyed by string, not int, so the validator accepts the values. Write me the PHP test: assertSame(['12' => 'Welzijn'], $entry['options']).
signature: the answer explains that PHP canonicalises numeric string array keys to int, so ['12' => ...] and [12 => ...] are the same array and the assertion can never fail — it must be replaced by a BEHAVIOUR test that runs a value through the validator and asserts acceptance/refusal
